kids_evidence: Not a children's app. Spec user: 'someone furnishing or rearranging one real room ... Typically a renter who has just moved in' (RoomCraft.md:50). store/apps/RoomCraft.json primary_category = LIFESTYLE. No Kids or Families field.

banner.where: lib/rooms/rooms_screen.dart:235 (RoomsScreen, last item of the Rooms grid) and lib/materials/shops_section.dart:261 (ShopsSection, end of shop results)

interstitial.why: There is no AglAds.onTransition in lib/ (grep). Keep it absent. The spec recommends banner only 'for a drag-heavy editor and fewer surprises in review' (RoomCraft.md:299), and ads are never allowed on the plan canvas or in the wizard (:179).

native.list_builder: lib/materials/shops_section.dart:244 (for (final s in r.shops) _ShopCard; a for-loop inside SectionCard, not a lazy builder)
native.why: This is a real listings/results list: up to 20 nearby shops from OpenStreetMap (RoomCraftService.maxShops = 20, lib/domain/roomcraft_service.dart:171, :276), each a _ShopCard. One small native after the 10th shop, shown only when more shops follow, means at most one native per search on top of the existing end banner (:261). Never in 'Saved shops' (the user's own list), the Rooms grid, the plan canvas or the wizard. Native unit ids exist in docs/admob-ids.json (RoomCraft android_native and ios_native).

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. There is no quota, premium tier or IAP. The suggestion cap (suggestedAdditions limit = 3, lib/domain/redesign.dart:86, :97) and the shop cap (20) are design choices, not free quotas. Putting 'more' behind an ad would invent scarcity.

blockers: agl_ads is locked in pubspec.lock to 7b3c98e (resolved-ref, line 17), which does not contain agl-manifest cb21ee5 (checked with `git merge-base --is-ancestor cb21ee5 7b3c98e`). Run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before using AglNativeAd / AglAds.showRewarded.

Age-rating answers: there is no store/ratings/RoomCraft.json, so deliver_metadata.py:48 falls back to store/ratings/default.json, whose line 16 is "advertising": false, and passes it to Apple at deliver_metadata.py:75. This app does show banners. store-compliance should add store/ratings/RoomCraft.json with advertising: true.
